caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular area filled with a repeated geometric pattern on a beige or off-white background. The primary area is a brown field featuring a grid of alternating blue and red shapes. The blue shapes are composed of vertical, horizontal, and grid-like lines that form squares and rectangles, some of which have extensions resembling combs or ladders. The red shapes consist of solid red squares, arranged in a grid with thin brown lines running through them, dividing some squares into four quarters. The blue and red shapes are distributed evenly throughout the brown field, forming a repeating pattern. On the right and bottom edges of the brown field, there are fringes composed of vertical lines in red, white, blue, and brown, resembling the edge of a textile or rug. The composition is highly regular, with the geometric shapes and lines aligned precisely within the rectangular format.
title: Woven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
